mapper.select: SELECT scope_key team,COUNT(*) members,MAX(CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.primary')=TRUE THEN subject_user_id END) leader_id FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' AND is_active=1 GROUP BY scope_key ORDER BY scope_key
mapper.sql: CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.legacyId')) AS UNSIGNED) id,scope_key team,subject_user_id user_id,config_subtype role,JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.primary') `primary`,is_active active
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' AND is_active=1 AND scope_key=#{team}
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.legacyId')) AS UNSIGNED)=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ONCALL_SCHEDULE' AND subject_user_id=#{userId} AND scope_key=#{team} AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND effective_to>NOW()

SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.legacyId')) AS UNSIGNED) id,scope_key team,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.name')) name,config_subtype type,subject_user_id user_id,secondary_user_id escalation_user_id,effective_from start,effective_to end,record_status status,record_version version FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ONCALL_SCHEDULE' AND scope_key=#{team} AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND effective_to>#{start} AND effective_from<#{end} ORDER BY effective_from,id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ONCALL_SCHEDULE' AND scope_key=#{team} AND config_subtype=#{type} AND record_status='ACTIVE' AND effective_from<#{end} AND effective_to>#{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='TEAM_MEMBER' AND subject_user_id=#{userId} AND scope_key=#{team} AND is_active=1
